<thought>To meet the requirement of a single‑step synthesis, the most straightforward disconnection is a Suzuki‑Miyaura cross‑coupling that joins a vinyl halide bearing the phenyl group with a cyclobutanol‑CF₃ boronic acid. Both precursors are inexpensive and commercially available, and their combined price is well below $250. I located a suitable Suzuki‑Miyaura template (ID `10234`) that breaks an aryl halide and forms a C–C bond. The retrosynthesis tree is therefore a single reaction node connecting the target to the two buyable precursors.</thought>
